name: Lena
source:
At first glance, Lena seems like an energetic and even a little carefree girl. However, her smile is just a cover for deep sadness and a past she tries not to talk about.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3615870/Farewell_we_see_each_other_for_the_last_time/]Steam[/url]]

Her zodiac sign is Scorpio.
